verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim documents synthetic data generation, including labeled training data via Replicator and controllable custom data pipelines. Isaac Lab documents reinforcement learning with GPU-optimized, headless training that scales from a single GPU to a cluster. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale RL throughput and synthetic-data pipelines (all evidence is vendor documentation).

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate synthetic training data and run reinforcement learning at scale in simulation

citations.quote: Generate labeled training data from Isaac Sim scenes with Replicator.
Isaac Sim also supports controllable synthetic data generation, letting developers build custom data pipelines that complement their existing data sources.
It supports both imitation and reinforcement learning methods.

Run fast, large-scale training with GPU-optimized simulation paths built on Warp and NVIDIA® CUDA®-graphable environments, and deploy easily with standalone headless operation, from workstation to data center.
Scale training from a single GPU to an entire cluster.
NVIDIA Isaac™ Lab is an open-source, GPU-accelerated, agent-ready simulation framework for robot learning designed to train robot policies at scale.
